review.notes: Extracted text of all 30 physical pages compared against the OCR markdown with a normalized line-presence scan (case/punctuation-insensitive). All body text, footnote/affiliation notes (project lead, joint first author, equal contribution, directional lead on p.1), the Dataset Card Q&A (Appendix F) and reference entries survive in the OCR. No code fences, no dropped footnote bodies, no spaced digits found. Scan flags were ligature artifacts ('fi'/'fl' correctly transcribed as ASCII) or figure-internal text hoisted next to Figure 1, which is not a defect. Table-heavy appendix pages were covered by the same scan; per-cell numeric proofreading of every evaluation table was not exhaustive within the review budget.

unresolved.evidence: OCR HTML tables were present and structurally coherent; exhaustive per-cell numeric verification against renders was out of the review budget.
